Identity slots are capped at five thousand and rented by the epoch instead of bought once. A ticket takes 200 POA down plus 5 POA of demurrage every six hours, and a missed payment voids standing while the slot returns to the open auction. Fifty clones pay 250 POA an epoch, 1,000 a day, forever, and must keep bidding because the other 4,950 slots never sit idle. One honest attestation round covers the rent.

A row of beacons on a cliff burns oil whether or not a ship reads it; yarrow seeds open ground, velvet stays where the soil is already tended.
